name: Vanilla+
description: The game as it was meant to be, with two things it cannot give you any more. Chao reach their Max-tier effects without wireless trading - the game gates level 2 behind trading with one person and level 3 behind a *different* person, tracking who rather than how often, so in 2026 two thirds of the Chao system is sealed for good. And every character who joins mid-game is put on Sonic's XP curve: they ship with curves that assume a head start, so Shadow needs 44% more XP than Sonic to reach level 8 and 132% more to reach level 2, which punishes you for using them. Nothing else is touched - no scaling, no cap change, no shuffle.
